long_biography.plain_text:
Gabrielle's Angel Foundation turned Denise Rich's promise to her daughter into a durable programme for blood-cancer research. Rich co-founded the charity in 1996 after Gabrielle Rich Aouad died from acute myelogenous leukaemia, and she remains its president. Its medical board directs grants towards early-career investigators working on leukaemia, lymphoma and related cancers.

Music supplies another part of Rich's public contribution. Her songwriting catalogue includes work recorded by Celine Dion, Aretha Franklin, Mary J. Blige and other artists, while Denise Rich Songs combines publishing with collaborative writing programmes. She also wrote “Love Will Set You Free”. Proceeds from the recording raised more than $200,000 for Gabrielle's Angel Foundation and the T.J. Martell Foundation.
